title: Gratitude Shifts Atmosphere
seo_title: The Power of Gratitude: 1 Thessalonians 5:18 | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Complaints drain; gratitude shifts. A devotional on 1 Thessalonians 5:18 about thankfulness that changes you in hard circumstances.
verse_text: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
insight: Gratitude doesn’t change your circumstance; it changes you in it.
one_minute_win: Write down three things you’re grateful for today.
